First gate: existing component cards keep legacy statement/document/mapping/resolution fields; add wholeClaimStatement, statementScope='whole-claim-context', componentScope {status:'reported'|'unavailable',basis:'attributed-assessment-scopes-not-extracted-statements',descriptions:[assessmentId,scope,author,currency]}, claimComponentCoverage {mapped,unmapped,components:[componentId,mappingStatus,targetIds]}, formalStatements:[targetId,targetRevision,name,typeText,statementAuthority:'stored-canonical-type-text'|'manifest-supplied',resolution,parameters:{status:'unavailable',reason:'no-bound-structured-declaration-observation'},checkingScope:'inspect-checking-section',reuseApplicability:'not-checked']. Assessment scopes remain assertions, never extracted sub-statements; siblings include selected component too as full declared population, with counts and exact omission refs. No implication that an unmapped/unassessed component is false. Complete inputs and historical evidence still validated; <=32KiB JSON/text, pagination/refs preserved. Existing bundle path accepts component selection with no external evidence flags.

Next gate after first red/green: offline guide section exposition, explicit --claim/--component (API component_id) selects a guide step's paragraph revision/author, current/historical reviews and recheck notices beside selected component and exact current supporting statements. Use existing strict guide-v1 steps/reviews and assessments-v1; no silent schema extensions. Support --assessments for guide and existing bundle companion. Explicit caller component association remains a caller selection, not an attributed correspondence approval. Historical step/target bindings cannot borrow new current statements. Notices request recheck, never assert falsehood from changed digests. Source-goal check outputs may be cited by digest in existing guide sources; offline view does not import those as fresh checker authority. Preserve distinct conventional argument, unchecked adapter, unassessed correspondence, reviewed mismatch judgments.

Verification: independent red proposals -> root valid failure/Ruff/RadonCC+MI -> frozen tests -> distinct green proposal -> root integration -> independent audit/negative tests. First scope tests, existing result inspection/reference/bundle tests. Focused paragraph controls correct/omitted-boundary/broadened-average and revision change, then installed field qualification and bounded updated expert packet. Pre-green source-first scout complete. The r61 design is supportable by additive projection/API changes; no extractor, model, Lean, or new evidence family is needed. Read-only sources: `result_inspection.py` currently validates manifest/selectors, computes target selection and query binding before paging (# lines 21-42, 45-52, 74-82); `result_inspection_cards.py` creates all claim/component rows from exact `(claimId, componentId)` links and preserves current-only assessment/review status (#14-38, 53-109); `result_inspection_page.py` binds cursors to full input/query digest, emits bounded pages and source-referenced omissions (#25-84, 87-115). CLI and bundle adapters route exact claim/target and validate full bundle input boundaries (`result_cli.py:64-110`, `result_bundle_cli.py:40-55`). Existing tests establish large-component pagination, query/input cursor invalidation, exact omission references, long UTF-8 JSON/text parity, full receipt validation, and bundle relocation (`test_result_inspection.py`, `test_result_inspection_contract.py`, `test_result_inspection_references.py`, `test_result_inspection_hardening.py`, `test_result_guide_pagination.py`, `test_result_bundle_views.py`). No tests run; no files changed.

Source constraints for implementation/tests: preserve legacy `statement` and its reference exactly; expose `wholeClaimStatement` as the same unsliced claim text, with explicit whole-claim scope. Assessment scopes are authored strings attached only by exact claim+component; show current and historical rows with author/currency, but label `componentScope.status=reported` only if at least one current assessment exists. This denotes a current attributed report, never truth or a component sub-statement. Map only links carrying both this claimId and componentId. `claimComponentCoverage` should use the full declared `claim.components` population in authored order, include the selected component, report integer mapped/unmapped counts over that whole population, and keep pagination `total=1` for a component selector. Never use claim-wide target membership as component mapping. Formal statement rows are only the selected component’s actual mapped target IDs; each shows exact target revision/name/typeText, per-target resolution, and authority `stored-canonical-type-text` only when exact owner resolution is `resolved`, otherwise `manifest-supplied`. Preserve `sourceFreshness=not-assessed`, checking-section pointer, and `reuseApplicability=not-checked`; no text parsing into premises.

One contract clarification recommended before freeze: define interaction of `component_id` with optional `target_id`. I recommend conjunctive filtering of formalStatements to the intersection of the component’s own mapped target IDs and target_id; keep component.mapping/claimComponentCoverage full and component-local. A target linked to a sibling component must yield no statement for the selected component, even if it is linked elsewhere under the same claim. This makes the explicit no-borrow rule testable. Also state mapped/unmapped are counts over the whole claim and the selected component is included in the sibling population; these details are presently inferable but underspecified. Cursor binding must include `projectionVersion=2`, claim, component, target, section, limit, all companion/artifact/lineage input identities, and bundle identity; old projection cursors must fail. Keep complete-input validation before selection so malformed unrelated historical evidence still rejects. Budget component-sibling projection to avoid quadratic copies; component scopes/formal statements must be paginatable/truncatable under the existing 32 KiB JSON/text byte limit with truthful counts and references into `/claims/{i}/components`, `/links`, `/assessments/{i}/scope`, and `/targets/{i}/typeText` (never fabricated projection paths).

Useful future exact-bound owner: `result_resolution._resolve_target` (`result_resolution.py:97-165`) already binds a unique canonical declaration subject by artifactId+subjectId, complete rendered type identity, unique environment/toolchain and exact source anchor; `stored_candidate_type.candidate_type_evidence` rejects ambiguous/truncated/mismatched rendered type (`stored_candidate_type.py:21-68`). That is sufficient only for canonical stored type text, not premise decomposition. A possible separately-gated structured-premise source exists in semantic v4: stored application observation `selectedDeclaration` plus declaration binders validated by `validate_application_observation`/`validate_v4_context_populations`, and `_semantic_observation_results._validate_selected_declaration_owner` requires unique matching declaration in its check owner. Reuse would still need an explicit exact manifest-target-to-same-check-owner binding and stored execution/receipt validation; current component views do not establish that join. Therefore r61’s explicit `parameters.status=unavailable` remains correct and should not be relaxed from rendered type text alone.

Contract SHA-256 `11a5092d97c173f75244295a4b926df8e75e1cb682a4d9978c1ffb92330b0c4d`. Key source hashes: inspection `40c72f85c5d49b1f73c45b4570727ec268a2fc072d1e133aba9c8445c641d694`; cards `4b49257da26998dd8dbb4bbd0439c23079bedd4a953ec7bcd981d9e33743c5b2`; page `ada001c623f3d368f4ab91a1091703202c4e6d99ca63a9be40bf0b4dd44d7e60`; target resolution `8bfac1f315e605ef2ba137334a217da237b0d65750dcf12a01fd8bbc8fa2f1c6`; structured candidate type `f1bcf55e9abb6559659ad3db306a5dec3b302c8f03b01c4769d35e4ac340a99e`. Unresolved gates: root red/green integration and independent audit; later guide/paragraph gate; installed field qualification and external reader/evaluation gates remain separate, and 9.1 must remain open.
